Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class DashboardController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.DashboardController
@Controller @RequestMapping("/dashboard") public class DashboardController extends Object
Thymeleaf controller that renders the Daily Briefing dashboard and article-detail pages.

Serves GET /dashboard as a personalized briefing page with watchlist alerts, top headlines, trending keywords, regulatory events, and legal developments.

Serves GET /dashboard/articles?topic=...&sort=asc|desc by fetching up to 500 articles for the given topic via ArticleIngestionPort, sorting them by publishedAt in the requested direction (default: descending), and rendering the articles view. Null publishedAt values sort to the end in both directions.

Serves GET /dashboard/news by fetching articles for all configured topic names from NewsTopicProperties and grouping them into an ordered map for the news-listing template.

    • articles

      @GetMapping("/articles") public String articles(@RequestParam String topic, @RequestParam(defaultValue="desc") String sort, Principal principal, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Renders the article-detail page for a single topic/feed.

      Fetches up to articles for the given topic and sorts them by publishedAt. Articles with a null publishedAt appear last regardless of sort direction.

      Parameters:
      topic - exact topic label to filter by (URL-decoded by Spring MVC)
      sort - "asc" for oldest-first, "desc" (default) for newest-first
      model - Thymeleaf model
      Returns:
      Thymeleaf view name "articles"

    • newsListing

      @GetMapping("/news") public String newsListing(@RequestParam(defaultValue="asc") String sort, @RequestParam(defaultValue="title") String sortBy, Principal principal, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Renders the news listing page with all articles grouped by topic.

      Iterates through the configured topic names from NewsTopicProperties, fetches all articles for each topic, sorts them newest-first, and builds an ordered map of topic → articles for the template.

      Parameters:
      sort - "asc" for oldest-first, "desc" (default) for newest-first
      sortBy - "date" (default), "title", or "publication"
      model - Thymeleaf model
      Returns:
      Thymeleaf view name "news-listing"
